objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has conducted clean shutdowns of running VMs in ESXI environments using `vim-cmd vmsvc/power.off <vmid> > /dev/null 2>&1`. [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also forcibly terminated running VM processes using `esxcli vm process kill --type=force --world-id=<world_id> > /dev/null 2>&1`.(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
